تستنقذوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْقِذُوا (tastanqiḏū) /tas.tan.qi.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# تُسْتَنْقَذُوا (tustanqaḏū) /tus.tan.qa.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
